alex: Hey folks — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 that changes how we map API errors to SDK exceptions. Quick summary: 429/503 -> RetryableError, 500 -> ServerError, 400/422 -> ValidationError with field hints where available. Question: should we attach the upstream request_id onto the exception object (ex.request_id) so callers can return/ surface it? Or only log it? Also: what log level for the raw request/response payloads for debugging — DEBUG? worried about PII.

maria: I vote for putting request_id on the exception object. It makes correlation easy for customers (they can show support the id). Keep the full payload only in DEBUG and behind an env flag (REDWOOD_SDK_VERBOSE=true). Add a short message on the exception like "request failed (request_id=abc123)" so web UIs can show a friendly error and the id.

sam: Agree with maria. Add a boolean property `retryable` to exceptions so user code can do `if ex.retryable: backoff()` instead of inspecting types. For user-facing strings include just the first 8 chars of request id, full id in logs. Example patterns: RetryableError(retryable=true, request_id="...")

dan: Quick Python example that matches what I mean:

```py
class ApiError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, msg, code=None, request_id=None, retryable=False, raw=None):
        super().__init__(msg)
        self.code = code
        self.request_id = request_id
        self.retryable = retryable
        self.raw = raw  # only set when REDWOOD_SDK_VERBOSE

raise ApiError("rate limit", code=429, request_id=resp.headers.get('x-request-id'), retryable=True)
```

We should keep `raw` out of the default exception to avoid leaking PW or tokens downstream.

emily: For Node/JS we should mirror the shape so `err.requestId` and `err.retryable` exist. Streaming clients: stream errors sometimes arrive mid-stream without headers; ensure we attach the request id from the initial handshake if available. If not, set `request_id=null` but still surface a `trace_id` from the client side.

ci-bot: build / test pipeline for PR #482 passed (linux, macos, windows) :white_check_mark:

alex: awesome, thanks. @maria @sam @emily @dan — I'll update PR to add `request_id` and `retryable` fields on exceptions, limit `raw` to verbose mode, and add a concise `__str__` that includes the short id.

sam: ping me when updated, I'll review. also suggest adding a small snippet in the README showing how to log and send the id to support.

maria: also add an entry in CHANGELOG about the exception attributes (breaking? maybe minor). backcompat: keep old exception class names aliasing to new ones for at least one release.

emily: I'll add a tiny unit test for streaming case (simulate missing headers) — list test file: `tests/test_stream_errors.py`.

alex: plan: update PR by EOD, request review, if +1 we'll merge and cut a patch release. if anyone wants to discuss sync, 10-15m huddle at 16:30 today. otherwise we'll do async. thanks :pray:
